_how: Where to find things, for 'where' questions. One short line each, written for Bedrock and checked against the Minecraft Wiki (the page is in 'wiki'). 'also': other ids that get the same line. 'guide': a guide to offer with it. 'build': a mob you make, so 'how do I make one' gets this line too. Places are structures you can find; 'pic' is the item shown for one, 'askedAs' the ways kids say it. The build copies the lines into the book without the links.

allay.say: Allays are found in wooden cages at pillager outposts and in woodland mansions.

armadillo.say: Armadillos live in savannas and badlands.

axolotl.say: Axolotls live in lush caves, in the water underground.

bee.say: Bees live in bee nests that hang from trees, often near flowers.

blaze.say: Blazes live in Nether fortresses, around blaze spawners.

bogged.say: Bogged live in swamps and mangrove swamps, and in trial chambers.

breeze.say: Breezes come out of trial spawners in trial chambers, deep underground.

camel.say: Camels live in deserts, and there's one in the middle of each desert village.

camel_husk.say: Camel husks show up in deserts, with a husk and a parched riding on them.

cat.say: Cats live in villages and at swamp huts.

cave_spider.say: Cave spiders live in mineshafts, around cave spider spawners.

chicken.say: Chickens live in grassy places, like plains and forests.

copper_golem.say: You build a copper golem: put a carved pumpkin on top of a copper block.

cow.say: Cows live in grassy places, like plains and forests.

creaking.say: Creakings come out at night from a creaking heart, inside a pale oak tree in the pale garden.

creeper.say: Creepers come out in the dark, at night and in caves.

dolphin.say: Dolphins swim in most oceans, but not frozen or cold ones.

donkey.say: Donkeys live in plains, savannas and meadows.

drowned.say: Drowned live in oceans and rivers.

elder_guardian.say: Elder guardians live in ocean monuments. Each monument has 3, and they never come back.

enderman.say: Endermen come out in the dark in the Overworld, and they live in the Nether and the End too.

endermite.say: Endermites sometimes pop out when you throw an ender pearl.

ender_dragon.say: The Ender Dragon lives in the End. Find a stronghold and go through its End portal.

evoker.say: Evokers live in woodland mansions, and they show up in raids on villages.

fox.say: Foxes live in taiga forests, with the spruce trees.

frog.say: Frogs live in swamps and mangrove swamps.

ghast.say: Ghasts float around the Nether, in soul sand valleys, Nether wastes and basalt deltas.

happy_ghast.say: Grow one from a dried ghast: put it in water. Dried ghasts are found in soul sand valleys in the Nether.

glow_squid.say: Glow squid swim in dark water deep underground.

goat.say: Goats live high up in snowy mountains.

guardian.say: Guardians live in and around ocean monuments.

hoglin.say: Hoglins live in crimson forests and bastions, in the Nether.

horse.say: Horses live in plains and savannas.

husk.say: Husks come out in deserts, in place of most zombies.

iron_golem.say: Iron golems guard villages. You can also build one: 4 iron blocks in a T shape with a carved pumpkin on top.

llama.say: Llamas live in savannas and windswept hills.

magma_cube.say: Magma cubes live in the Nether, most of all in basalt deltas.

mooshroom.say: Mooshrooms only live in mushroom fields, a rare island biome.

mule.say: Mules don't spawn on their own. Breed a horse with a donkey to get one.

panda.say: Pandas live in jungles, most of all in bamboo jungles.

parched.say: Parched come out in deserts. They're a kind of skeleton.

phantom.say: Phantoms come out at night if you haven't slept for 3 days or more.

pig.say: Pigs live in grassy places, like plains and forests.

piglin.say: Piglins live in the Nether, in Nether wastes, crimson forests and bastions.

piglin_brute.say: Piglin brutes only live in bastions, in the Nether.

pillager.say: Pillagers live at pillager outposts, walk around in patrols, and come in raids on villages.

polar_bear.say: Polar bears live in snowy plains, ice spikes and frozen oceans.

pufferfish.say: Pufferfish swim in warm and lukewarm oceans.

rabbit.say: Rabbits live in deserts, flower forests, taigas and snowy places.

ravager.say: Ravagers come in raids on villages.

salmon.say: Salmon swim in rivers and cold oceans.

sheep.say: Sheep live in grassy places, like plains and forests.

shulker.say: Shulkers live in End cities, out on the End's outer islands.

silverfish.say: Silverfish hide inside stone blocks in strongholds and mountains, and pop out when you break them.

skeleton.say: Skeletons come out in the dark, at night and in caves.

skeleton_horse.say: Skeleton horses show up as a trap when lightning strikes in a thunderstorm.

slime.say: Slimes come out in swamps at night, and deep underground in some places called slime chunks.

sniffer.say: Sniffers hatch from sniffer eggs. Find the eggs in suspicious sand at warm ocean ruins.

snow_golem.say: You build a snow golem: put a carved pumpkin on top of 2 snow blocks.

spider.say: Spiders come out in the dark, at night and in caves.

squid.say: Squid swim in rivers and oceans.

stray.say: Strays come out in snowy places, in place of most skeletons.

strider.say: Striders walk on the lava seas in the Nether.

tadpole.say: Tadpoles hatch from frogspawn, the eggs frogs lay in water.

trader_llama.say: Trader llamas come with the wandering trader.

tropical_fish.say: Tropical fish swim in warm and lukewarm oceans.

vex.say: Vexes only show up when an evoker calls them.

vindicator.say: Vindicators live in woodland mansions, and they show up in raids on villages.

warden.say: The warden lives in the deep dark, far underground. Sculk shriekers call it, so sneak around them.

witch.say: Witches come out in the dark, and one lives in each swamp hut.

wither.say: The wither is a boss you build: 4 soul sand in a T shape with 3 wither skeleton skulls on top.

wither_skeleton.say: Wither skeletons live in Nether fortresses.

wolf.say: Wolves live in forests, taigas and savannas.

zoglin.say: A zoglin is a hoglin that left the Nether. Hoglins turn into zoglins in the Overworld.

zombie.say: Zombies come out in the dark, at night and in caves.

zombie_horse.say: Zombie horses are rare. Some come at night in plains and savannas, with a zombie riding them.

zombie_nautilus.say: Zombie nautiluses swim in oceans, with a drowned riding them.

zombie_villager.say: Some zombies are zombie villagers. A zombie can also turn a villager into one.

zombified_piglin.say: Zombified piglins live in the Nether, and sometimes show up near Nether portals.

diamond.say: Diamonds are deep underground. Look around level -59, near the bottom of the world.

raw_iron.say: Iron ore is in stone underground and in mountains. Level 16 is a good place to look.

raw_gold.say: Gold ore is deep underground, around level -16, and there's lots in badlands.

nether_gold_ore.say: Nether gold ore is all over the Nether. It gives you gold nuggets.

coal.say: Coal ore is easy to find in stone, in caves and high up in mountains.

raw_copper.say: Copper ore is in stone underground, most around level 48, and lots in dripstone caves.

redstone.say: Redstone ore is deep underground, near the bottom of the world.

lapis_lazuli.say: Lapis ore is underground, most around level 0.

emerald.say: Emerald ore is only in mountains. You can also get emeralds by trading with villagers.

ancient_debris.say: Ancient debris is in the Nether, most around level 16. You need a diamond pickaxe to mine it.

netherite_scrap.say: Netherite scrap comes from ancient debris, deep in the Nether. Smelt the debris in a furnace.

quartz.say: Nether quartz ore is all over the Nether.

amethyst_shard.say: Amethyst is inside amethyst geodes, round caves of purple crystal underground.

budding_amethyst.say: Budding amethyst is inside amethyst geodes. It breaks if you mine it, even with Silk Touch.

obsidian.say: Obsidian forms where water flows onto still lava. You can also find it at ruined portals.

elytra.say: Elytra are in End cities, in an item frame on the End ship. Beat the Ender Dragon first.

trident.say: Tridents come from drowned. Some drowned hold one, and they might drop it when you beat them.

totem_of_undying.say: Evokers always drop a totem of undying. Find them in woodland mansions and in raids.

heart_of_the_sea.say: The heart of the sea is in buried treasure chests on beaches. Treasure maps from shipwrecks and ocean ruins show where.

nautilus_shell.say: Drowned holding a nautilus shell can drop it. You can also fish one up or trade for one.

sponge.say: Sponges are in sponge rooms in ocean monuments. Elder guardians drop wet sponges too.

saddle.say: You can craft a saddle. You can also find saddles in chests, fish one up, or trade for one.

name_tag.say: You can craft a name tag. You can also find them in chests, fish one up, or trade for one.

echo_shard.say: Echo shards are in chests in ancient cities, in the deep dark.

trial_key.say: Trial keys come from trial spawners in trial chambers, after you beat their mobs.

heavy_core.say: Heavy cores are in ominous vaults in trial chambers. They're rare.

enchanted_golden_apple.say: Enchanted golden apples are rare finds in chests, like in mineshafts, dungeons, desert pyramids and ruined portals.

dragon_egg.say: The dragon egg shows up on top of the portal in the End after you beat the Ender Dragon.

slime_ball.say: Slimes drop slimeballs. Find slimes in swamps at night.

ender_pearl.say: Endermen drop ender pearls. You can also trade with villagers for them.

blaze_rod.say: Blazes drop blaze rods. Blazes live in Nether fortresses.

ghast_tear.say: Ghasts drop ghast tears. Find ghasts flying around the Nether.

shulker_shell.say: Shulkers drop shulker shells. They live in End cities.

wither_skeleton_skull.say: Wither skeletons sometimes drop their skull. They live in Nether fortresses.

breeze_rod.say: Breezes drop breeze rods. They're in trial chambers.

armadillo_scute.say: Armadillos drop a scute now and then. Brush an armadillo to get one.

goat_horn.say: Goats drop a horn when they ram into stone, logs, ore or packed ice. Pillager outposts have them too.

sniffer_egg.say: Sniffer eggs are in suspicious sand at warm ocean ruins. Use a brush to dig them out.

turtle_egg.say: Turtles lay turtle eggs on beaches after you feed them seagrass.

egg.say: Chickens lay eggs every few minutes.

honeycomb.say: Use shears on a full bee nest or beehive. Put a campfire under it first so the bees stay calm.

sugar_cane.say: Sugar cane grows next to water, on sand, dirt or grass.

cactus.say: Cactus grows in deserts and badlands.

pumpkin.say: Pumpkins grow in small patches in grassy places.

bamboo.say: Bamboo grows in jungles, most of all in bamboo jungles.

cocoa_beans.say: Cocoa pods grow on the sides of jungle trees.

sweet_berries.say: Sweet berry bushes grow in taigas.

oak_log.say: Logs come from trees. Chop the trunk of any tree.

sand.say: Sand is in deserts, on beaches, and on the bottom of rivers and oceans.

gravel.say: Gravel is underground, on beaches, and on the bottom of oceans.

clay_ball.say: Clay is on the bottom of lakes, rivers and swamps.

nether_wart.say: Nether wart grows in Nether fortresses and bastions.

glowstone_dust.say: Glowstone hangs from the ceiling in the Nether. Break it to get glowstone dust.

dried_ghast.say: Dried ghasts are in soul sand valleys in the Nether, next to big bone fossils. You can also make one.

pointed_dripstone.say: Pointed dripstone grows in dripstone caves, underground.

moss_block.say: Moss is in lush caves, underground.

mud.say: Mud is in mangrove swamps. You can also make it: use a water bottle on dirt.

milk_bucket.say: Use an empty bucket on a cow, a goat or a mooshroom to fill it with milk.

water_bucket.say: Use an empty bucket on water to fill it.

bell.say: Bells are in villages, at the meeting place in the middle.

spawner.say: Spawners are in dungeons, mineshafts, Nether fortresses, strongholds and woodland mansions. You can't pick one up.

village.name: Village
village.say: Villages are in plains, deserts, savannas, taigas, meadows and snowy plains.

stronghold.name: Stronghold
stronghold.say: Strongholds are hidden underground. Throw an eye of ender: it flies toward the nearest one.

woodland_mansion.name: Woodland mansion
woodland_mansion.say: Woodland mansions are in dark forests and pale gardens. They're rare and far away, so a map from a cartographer villager helps.

ocean_monument.name: Ocean monument
ocean_monument.say: Ocean monuments are underwater in deep oceans.

nether_fortress.name: Nether fortress
nether_fortress.say: Nether fortresses are in the Nether, in any biome. They're made of dark Nether bricks.

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.say: Bastions are in the Nether, in every biome but basalt deltas. They're full of piglins and gold.

end_city.name: End city
end_city.say: End cities are on the End's outer islands. Beat the Ender Dragon, then go through the small gateway portal.

ancient_city.name: Ancient city
ancient_city.say: Ancient cities are in the deep dark, far underground, often under mountains.

trial_chambers.name: Trial chambers
trial_chambers.say: Trial chambers are underground, around level -40 to -20.

pillager_outpost.name: Pillager outpost
pillager_outpost.say: Pillager outposts are dark wooden towers in the same kinds of places as villages, but rarer.

desert_pyramid.name: Desert pyramid
desert_pyramid.say: Desert pyramids are in deserts. Watch out for the trap under the treasure room.

jungle_pyramid.name: Jungle temple
jungle_pyramid.say: Jungle temples are in jungles. Watch out for the traps inside.

swamp_hut.name: Swamp hut
swamp_hut.say: Swamp huts are in swamps. A witch and a black cat live there.

igloo.name: Igloo
igloo.say: Igloos are in snowy plains and snowy taigas. Some have a secret basement.

shipwreck.name: Shipwreck
shipwreck.say: Shipwrecks are in oceans and on beaches.

buried_treasure.name: Buried treasure
buried_treasure.say: Buried treasure is under the sand on beaches. Treasure maps from shipwrecks and ocean ruins show where.

ruined_portal.name: Ruined portal
ruined_portal.say: Ruined portals are all over the Overworld and the Nether.

mineshaft.name: Mineshaft
mineshaft.say: Mineshafts are underground, with rails and wooden beams. In badlands some are above ground.

monster_room.name: Dungeon
monster_room.say: Dungeons are small mossy rooms underground with a mob spawner and chests.

trail_ruins.name: Trail ruins
trail_ruins.say: Trail ruins are buried in taigas, jungles and old birch forests. Brush the suspicious gravel to find treasure.

amethyst_geode.name: Amethyst geode
amethyst_geode.say: Amethyst geodes are underground, from deep down up to level 30.

nether_fossil.name: Nether fossil
nether_fossil.say: Nether fossils are big bones in soul sand valleys, in the Nether.

ocean_ruins.name: Ocean ruins
ocean_ruins.say: Ocean ruins are on the ocean floor. Warm oceans have sandstone ones and cold oceans have stone ones.
